description:
## Bug fixes
- **overlay-buttons:** causes `exit code = 1` error while patching on Android 6.0 Manager
- **spoof-player-parameters:** Videos are incorrectly recorded to watch history when autoplay in feed
  - (side issue: autoplay in feed may stops by buffering)
- **microg-support:** MicroG missing warning does not appear on low-end devices
- **materialyou:** Throws proper exception to avoid aborting on A6-7 Manager. (Material You needs Android 12+, so this patch should not be selected.)

## Features
- Add `disable-landscape-mode` patch (excluded by default)
- **hide-general-ads:** Update ads filter to hide new type of ads
- **custom-branding-name:** Improve patching speed
  - On my old low-end phone, patching time reduced from 15 minutes to 0.005 seconds!
- **translations:** Update Ukrainian translation (#28)
- **settings:** Improve categorize to make it closer to the current version of RVX
- **os-version-check:** Improve warning message
- **spoof-app-signatures:** improve settings text

## Removed features
- Remove `hide-shorts-navbar` patch
  - This patch needs spoof app version to 17.40.xx+, but spoofing to 17.40+ is broken now, so this patch no longer works.
- **overlay-buttons:** Remove whitelist feature
  - Whitelist feature is broken because YouTube API v1 has been ended.

## etc
- refactor(enable-minimized-playback): Remove revanced settings toggle (it was a duplicate of YT settings)
- build: bump revanced-patcher to 14.2.2
- No longer compatible with Reis's ReVanced builder. Use RVX Builder instead (inotia's fork).
- Default video speed bug is not solved yet sorry

※ Compatible ReVanced Manager (official): v1.9.5
※ Compatible ReVanced Manager (Android 6-7): v1.9.5
※ Compatible ReVanced CLI: v3.1.1
